title: Innokin Kwik 35K Cola Ice Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Cola Ice recreates the familiar taste of classic Cola, blending sweet soda flavour with a refreshing hint of ice. The result is a smooth, fizzy profile that’s bright and satisfying to vape. Each pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod and 10ml refill container designed for the Innokin Kwik 35K. The mesh-coil pod maintains clear flavour throughout, while the auto-feed dual chamber prevents dry hits. Browse the full flavour collection of Innokin Kwik 35k Pods today. How to Set Up Innokin Kwik 35K Prefilled Pod Step 1 Insert the prefilled pod into the Kwik 35K device until it clicks. Step 2 Fit the 10ml refill container securely into the base compartment. Step 3 Inhale on the mouthpiece to vape. Replace the pod pack once both chambers are empty. ✅ You're all set!
